draft_text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline significantly outperformed Varrow-NMT in BLEU (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
revised_text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline achieved a higher mean BLEU than Varrow-NMT (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
rationale: T1 shows mean BLEU 28.4 (Tessaline) vs 27.6 (Varrow-NMT), a numerical difference. However, the only reported statistical test (S1) is for Tessaline vs PhraseGrid (cmp2), not vs Varrow-NMT (cmp1). No significance test is reported for the Tessaline–Varrow-NMT comparison, so "significantly" is unsupported. The narrower claim of a higher mean BLEU is supported.
